en: A multi-view color postcard showing four scenes of a small alpine village surrounded by forests and green hillsides. The upper-left image shows the village nestled in a valley with scattered houses and a church spire. The upper-right and lower-left images depict chalet-style houses or guesthouses with balconies and outdoor terraces, one with umbrellas and seating. The lower-right image shows a small town square or street corner with a few multi-story buildings, balconies with flowers, and a shop at street level. In the center, in red text on a white panel, is the title 'TRET di Fondo m. 1162'.
